TS0440001.message: Pipeline {pipeline} has no running job to act on.
TS0440001.solution: Start the pipeline before pausing or resuming it, and check the id for typos.

TS0440002.message: Chain {chain} reached generation {epoch} position {seq}, past what the engine encodes an ordering value in.
TS0440002.solution: Report this with the pipeline: the range is a build-time width, and no configuration widens it.

TS0440003.message: This member may no longer act for pipeline `{pipeline}`: its run is not the current one.
TS0440003.solution: Let the member that holds the pipeline's claim run it; check cluster connectivity to the coordination store if no member is running it.

TS0440004.message: Pipeline {pipeline} stopped because its execution lease expired or was replaced.
TS0440004.solution: Check the current run owner and coordination-store connectivity; confirm the current run state before acting.

TS0440005.message: Pipeline {pipeline} stopped because it could not confirm renewal of its execution lease.
TS0440005.solution: Restore coordination-store connectivity and confirm the current run owner before deciding whether to restart.

TS0440006.message: Pipeline {pipeline} could not be started: its previous run was still ending after {seconds}s.
TS0440006.solution: Wait for the previous run to finish stopping and start the pipeline again; if it never does, check the member's logs for a processor that is not shutting down.

TS0440007.message: View {view} cannot apply a {operation} because its earlier row does not carry the selected alternate key {key}.
TS0440007.solution: Configure the source so update and delete before images carry {key}, then start the pipeline again.

TS0440008.message: Pipeline {pipeline} stopped because its job failed: {cause}.
TS0440008.solution: Check the pipeline's logs for the failure, fix what it reports, then start the pipeline again.

TS0440009.message: Pipeline {pipeline} stopped because the engine ran out of memory and shut down.
TS0440009.solution: The server reports itself unhealthy until it is restarted. Restart it with a larger Java heap (for example -XX:MaxRAMPercentage or -Xmx), or run fewer pipelines at once, then start the pipeline again.

TS0440010.message: Chain {chain} has not advanced its durable position for {minutes} minutes ({cause}; the bound combined for it has run {gap} ahead).
TS0440010.solution: The source keeps its log from that position onwards, so act before the log's retention passes it: if the chain is waiting on changes still pending upstream, find what is holding them; if it is starved of positions, the sink has nothing to advance to and the source must supply them.

TS0440011.message: A second row of join source {source} arrived under key {key}, replacing the row already filed under it; that row is now unreachable and every row matching this key joins to the new one.
TS0440011.solution: The join matches {source} on a column that does not identify its rows, so two of them share one key. Match it on a column that is unique in that source, or narrow the source so only one row can hold the key. Until then the target holds fewer rows than the query describes.

TS0440012.message: A change on stream {stream} reached node {node} without its key ({columns}), so it cannot be routed to the processor that holds the other changes of its row.
TS0440012.solution: Make sure every change on {stream} carries {columns} - in the later image, or in the earlier one for a removal - or set execution.parallelism to 1 on {node}.

TS0440013.message: An update on stream {stream} changed its row's key at node {node}, which runs on several processors; the change cannot be kept in order with both keys.
TS0440013.solution: Set execution.parallelism to 1 on {node} if rows on {stream} change their key; one processor applies such changes in order.

TS0440014.message: Pipeline {pipeline} was planned for {planned} members but started on {actual}; it was stopped before any processor ran.
TS0440014.solution: Nothing to do: the next start works the plan out again for the members present then.

TS0440015.message: The cluster refused operations on operator state `{state}` for {seconds}s, so the run stopped.
TS0440015.solution: Check that every member can reach the coordination store and see the others; start the pipeline again once the cluster reports its full membership.
